slides.title: What Happened Wednesday, Nov 25
slides.body: October PCE inflation rose 0.3% on the month and 3.8% from a year earlier. Core PCE, which excludes food and energy, was up 3.3%.

slides.title: The Numbers: October PCE
slides.subtitle: PCE inflation, % year over year
slides.body: Core came in above the 3.2% economists expected. Q3 GDP was revised up to 4.3%.

slides.title: Why It Matters
slides.body: Futures priced a 97% chance of a December Fed hike, per CME FedWatch. Strong growth plus hotter core inflation leaves less room to wait.
